findings_inline.hypothesis_1: F2 fix (commit 205fc6668) `customers` computed filter removes the freshly-seeded customer if Vuex `user/lists` hasn't refreshed when injection happens — vue-select then has empty/wrong selection — confirmOrder rejects without POST.
findings_inline.hypothesis_2: F2 `_destroyed` flag in beforeUnmount fires prematurely if Vue navigates POS internally (cart reset between order 1 and 2 may trigger partial unmount).
findings_inline.hypothesis_3: Test env race: spec injects address_id directly into Vue internals but doesn't wait for customers/lists Vuex action to load freshly-seeded user; confirmOrder() may pre-check `customers.find(c=>c.id===form.customer_id)` and skip if not yet present.
findings_inline.fix_proposal: Add explicit Vuex action dispatch `await $store.dispatch('user/list')` (or equivalent) after pre-seeding customer in beforeAll, BEFORE proceeding to spec body. Alternatively: revisit F2's `_destroyed` flag — make it window.confirm-aware (only set on true unmount, not on partial vnode patches).
findings_inline.downstream_mitigation: Wave B/C/D will consume Order #70 (R1 fallback) for delivery path testing — Order #70 still has TPE/DELIVERY/total=19 metadata in DB and is in PRÊTS À SERVIR per state 17 capture.
